content.title: Parade Schedule – St. Patrick's Day  New Orleans
content.text: Our annual St. Patrick’s Day Parades are considered another opportunity for family and friends to get together and enjoy a day outdoors. It seems as if the entire city is on the street with picnic baskets, umbrellas, and their recreational vehicles – enjoying one of the biggest street parties of the year! Men and women in walking groups from various clubs in the city dress in costumes of green and give out flowers, beads, and kisses to lucky parade goers along the route. This block party has Irish music, food, drinks, and dancers, and proceeds benefit St. Michael's Special School. Downtown Irish Club Parade 6:30 p.m. Marigny Triangle The Downtown Irish Club’s St. Patrick’s Day Parade will begin in the Marigny and wind its way through the French Quarter and Warehouse District, celebrating 50 years of Irish pride, music, and tradition. Starting Location: Marigny Brasserie (Frenchmen Street) The parade will proceed along Frenchmen Street to Balcony Music Club – BMC, then turn left onto Esplanade Avenue and right onto South Peters Street. We will pause in historic Jackson Square for the official presentation of our Grand Marshal, King, and Queen. While in the Square, the parade will also make a celebratory stop at the Corner Oyster House. The... March 22, 2026 March 28, 2026 Italian-American St. Joseph’s Parade in the French Quarter 6:00 p.m. French Quarter The St. Joseph's Society celebrates St. Joseph with a parade through the French Quarter. The parade kicks off at 6 p.m. at the intersection of Convention Center Blvd. and Girod Street. It includes 16 floats, nine marching bands and a whole lot of guys dressed in tuxedos. April 11, 2026 St. Bernard Irish Italian Islenos Parade 12:00 p.m. Chalmette The St. Bernard Irish Italian Islenos Community Parade is one of the largest events in nearby St. Bernard parish. The parade starts at 12noon along the W. Judge Perez route in Chalmette - from Meraux Dr. down to Ventura and back! It consists of 53+ floats, 35+marching groups 1,500+ members and 350,000 pounds of produce!
